name.title: Receiver Name
name.description: The name of the Receiver accessory as shown in Apple Home.

host.title: IP Address / Hostname
host.description: Ethernet IP address of the Trinnov Altitude.

port.title: Automation Port
port.description: Trinnov ASCII automation TCP port (default is 44100).

mac.title: MAC Address (for Wake-on-LAN)
mac.description: The Altitude network interface MAC address. Required for Power On, as the Trinnov processor enters complete standby and wakes via WoL magic packets.

minVolumeDb.title: Minimum Volume (dB)
minVolumeDb.description: Volume corresponding to 0% in HomeKit (default: -90.0 dB).

maxVolumeDb.title: Maximum Volume (dB)
maxVolumeDb.description: Volume corresponding to 100% in HomeKit (default: 0.0 dB; protects speakers from accidental max volume).

volumeAccessoryType.title: In-Room Volume Slider Type

oneOf.title: Fan Slider (0-100% slider on the Receiver, immune to 'Turn off the lights')
Light Dimmer Slider (0-100% brightness slider on the Receiver)

volumeAccessoryType.description: In-room 0-100% volume slider attached to the Receiver accessory.

enableMuteSwitch.title: Enable Dedicated Mute Switch
enableMuteSwitch.description: Exposes a Mute toggle switch on the Receiver.

enableBypassSwitch.title: Enable Optimizer Bypass Switch
enableBypassSwitch.description: Exposes a toggle switch on the Receiver to bypass or engage the Trinnov Acoustic Optimizer.

inputs.title: Named Input Sources (Profiles)
inputs.description: Only profiles with a name entered here will appear in the Receiver's input picker. Unnamed profiles are ignored.

presets.title: Named Presets
presets.description: Only presets with a name entered here will be exposed on the Receiver. Unnamed presets are ignored.
